notes.title: Open Beta
notes.content:
This beta will available on Steam. There is not a limit on the number of beta keys available, however the signup period will close on January 10th to allow me time to retrieve the keys from Valve. To sign up, visit [url=https://www.pluggedvr.com/]pluggedvr.com[/url].

Features in the beta:
[list]
[*] Character customization
[*] Public Matchmaking
[*] Private Games with Steam Friends Integration
[*] Brawlers - Classic Arena Action
[/list]

Please note: the beta and demo will currently be playable only through Steam and SteamVR. All major retailer headsets will be compatible, Including:

[list]
[*] HTC Vive
[*] Valve Index
[*] Oculus Rift S
[*] Oculus Quest (via link cable)
[*] Most WMR systems
[/list]

The final release will be available on the Oculus Rift and Quest stores, there is just not a presence there as of yet.

It's going to be a fun winter! look forward to seeing you all!

-Michael
